summary: Created a 4-phase serial plan implementing the research-settled design: a standalone --reap action on setup-sapience-mcp.sh, writer-level fixture cases, an ungated reap invocation in the restructured SessionStart hook with array-based notice assembly, then docs plus redeploy, installer refresh and the full gate set. Premise re-validation found the description's cited stale entry no longer reproduces (that row now carries mcpServers:{}; zero orphaned server rows across all 41 project rows), so the plan moves discriminating evidence to fixtures and reframes live acceptance as a no-wrongful-reap regression check. Two mechanics not in the report were added: --reap must short-circuit before resolve_interpreter's hard exit 1, and the hook's jq/writer guards must hoist above the manifest-reachability branch.

artifacts.summary: 4-phase, 3.5-hour plan adding a cross-project --reap mode to the sapience MCP writer and an ungated reap pass to the SessionStart hook, with fixture coverage, docs, redeploy and installer refresh.
